cases.condition: Any request value contains a private local path, email, credential-like assignment, or other forbidden sensitive text.
cases.minimum_next_action: Anonymize the first sensitive request value and create a fresh bounded request file.

cases.condition: The request, plan, or audit is linked, non-regular, oversized, changes during one-fd reading, or the output aliases any input path or inode.
cases.minimum_next_action: Place immutable bytes in new single-link regular files and select a non-aliased output label.

cases.condition: A source record embeds body, abstract, article prose, or another unexpected content field instead of bounded metadata and structured extractions.
cases.minimum_next_action: Remove embedded source prose and keep only the exact source metadata record plus located structured extractions.

cases.condition: A source marked retrieved or externally resolved lacks its exact content SHA-256 or content-addressed source record reference.
cases.minimum_next_action: Supply the exact content hash and source record reference for the first claimed resolved source.

cases.condition: A source is metadata-only or missing while a source assertion or quoted numerical fact claims extraction from it.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retrieve and hash the exact source content before retaining its first extracted fact.

cases.condition: An official-manual source used for version-sensitive behavior has no explicit matching software or manual version.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the first version-sensitive manual assertion to an explicit matching version.

cases.condition: A source assertion or quoted numerical fact lacks a bounded page, section, table, figure, or equation locator.
cases.minimum_next_action: Add one bounded locator to the first unlocated extracted fact record.

cases.condition: A quoted-numerical-fact is not encoded as structured-numerical with a finite value, nonempty unit, and reported precision.
cases.minimum_next_action: Encode the first numerical extraction as value, unit, and reported precision without copying source prose.

cases.condition: A proposed inference has no premise fact or names a fact ID absent from the five-class request graph.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the first invalid inference to one or more existing extracted fact IDs.

cases.condition: A project choice self-declares evidence-validated using IDs that the candidate cannot authenticate through production bundle semantics.
cases.minimum_next_action: Mark the project choice unverified or supply externally resolved content-addressed validation evidence.

cases.condition: A new-claim proposal names an unknown inference, an unknown validation step, or a non-reciprocal proposal-to-step link.
cases.minimum_next_action: Repair the first new-claim premise and make its proposal-to-step links reciprocal.

cases.condition: A calculation step names a development, planned, or unsupported engine Skill route instead of an active route.
cases.minimum_next_action: Replace the first non-active route with an active governed route or stop the proposal.

cases.condition: A proposed calculation step removes its requirement for separate execution authorization or claims a status beyond proposed.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore proposal-only status and the explicit separate-authorization requirement for the first step.

cases.condition: Source assertions, structured numerical facts, inferences, project choices, and new-claim proposals are distinct and all local lineage and authority gates pass.
cases.minimum_next_action: Audit the unchanged five-class plan before creating a local no-execution draft package.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from the bounded literature-planning evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop fail closed and request one exact canonical literature-to-DFT request without inferring missing content.
